correctness.rationale: For \(q=2\), the two admissible noise words are complements; output sets coincide exactly on complementary input pairs. There are \(2^{n-1}\) pairs, so the maximum size and the count of all transversals follow. For \(q\ge3\), the recursive difference construction excludes at most two symbols at each step and produces two proper noise words with any prescribed difference, making every pair of distinct inputs confusable.
